title: Microsoft Purview: network DLP policies for all websites through Entra Internet Access
summary: Hold: the risk section's device restriction excludes hybrid-joined devices, although Microsoft's content-policy instructions support them and the scope section correctly reports that distinction. The roadmap facts, licence combinations and documented controls otherwise check out; the control paths need minor expansions.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans all-websites scoping for Purview network data security DLP through Entra GSA Internet Access.
claims.quote: admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites

claims.claim: The planned scope can cover all websites except specific cloud apps.
claims.quote: or all websites except specific cloud apps

claims.claim: The roadmap says the new scope enables protection of apps and websites outside the Defender Cloud App Catalog.
claims.quote: allowing them to apply protection to cloud apps and websites that are not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

claims.quote: Searched: Purview network data security all websites 575285 default existing policies licensing price scope; "Purview" "all websites" "scope". Read roadmap, network data security overview, DLP walkthrough and Entra content-policy page; no existing-policy migration behaviour is stated.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not yet document the all-websites scope picker or its exceptions.
claims.quote: Searched: "Purview" "all websites" "scope". Read network data security overview, DLP walkthrough and Entra content-policy page; they describe catalog apps and adaptive app scopes, not the new all-websites picker.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; controls[0].note

claims.quote: Unmanaged cloud apps - Network data security collection policies support all the sources that are in the Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps Cloud app catalog

claims.claim: The catalog contains over 35,000 discoverable cloud apps.
claims.quote: Cloud app catalog which includes over 35,000 discoverable cloud apps.

claims.claim: Adaptive app scopes include generative AI, cloud storage, collaboration, social network and webmail categories.
claims.quote: Adaptive app scopes - all apps in multiple categories including generative AI, cloud storage, collaboration, social network, and webmail.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Network data security supports the Audit only action.
claims.quote: Actions - Network data security supports Audit only and Block actions.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Network data security supports Block, including blocking sensitive uploads.
claims.quote: Select Text sent to or shared with cloud or AI apps and File uploaded to or shared with cloud or AI apps. Select Block for both.

claims.claim: GSA content policies and corresponding Purview Inline web traffic DLP policies are separate required parts of Scan with Purview.
claims.quote: Without a matching Purview DLP policy, the content policy can't inspect selected file or text content or enforce audit or block decisions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The Entra content-policy page limits Scan with Purview file content to 3 MB.
claims.quote: The maximum supported content size for Scan with Purview is 3 MB for both file and text content types.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The Entra content-policy page limits Scan with Purview text content to 3 MB.
claims.quote: The maximum supported content size for Scan with Purview is 3 MB for both file and text content types.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: OCR is not yet supported for traffic sent to Purview.
claims.quote: OCR is not yet supported for traffic sent to Purview.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Scan with Purview inspects only traffic mapped to an Entra user identity.
claims.quote: Scan with Purview only applies to traffic associated with an Entra user identity. Traffic that cannot be mapped to an Entra user identity is not sent to Purview for inspection.

claims.claim: The Purview overview separately gives a 4 MB inline evaluation limit for uploadText and downloadText.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview evaluates up to 4 MB of content for uploadText and downloadText

claims.claim: The Purview overview gives a 3 MB inline evaluation limit for uploadFile and downloadFile.
claims.quote: and files up to 3 MB for uploadFile and downloadFile.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Purview network data security policies do not apply to B2B guests.
claims.quote: Purview network data security policies don't apply to B2B guest users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity, first bullet
claims.claim: A site only reaches Purview through the stated Entra ID joined device chain, so an all-websites DLP policy does nothing for devices outside it.
claims.quote: The Global Secure Access client requires a device (or virtual machine) that is either Microsoft Entra ID joined or Microsoft Entra ID Hybrid joined.
claims.fix: Remove 'A site only reaches Purview through that chain, so an all-websites DLP policy does nothing for devices outside it.' Retain Scope's distinction between the walkthrough's Entra ID joined requirement and the content-policy page's joined-or-hybrid-joined requirement.

claims.claim: The Entra content-policy page permits Entra ID joined or hybrid-joined devices.
claims.quote: The Global Secure Access client requires a device (or virtual machine) that is either Microsoft Entra ID joined or Microsoft Entra ID Hybrid joined.

claims.claim: The documented GSA integration requires TLS inspection.
claims.quote: If you're using Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access ... You must configure a Transport Layer Security inspection policy

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; controls[2].note; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Global Secure Access Administrator is required to configure GSA content policies.
claims.quote: A user with the Global Secure Access Administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID to configure Global Secure Access settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: DLP Compliance Management is an example of a required Purview DLP role.
claims.quote: You need a role such as DLP Compliance Management or Information Protection Admin

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Information Protection Admin is another example of a required Purview DLP role.
claims.quote: You need a role such as DLP Compliance Management or Information Protection Admin

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The network DLP policy mode offers simulation before enforcement.
claims.quote: On the Policy mode page, choose Turn the policy on immediately or run in simulation mode first to test.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Traffic is allowed when Purview inspection cannot complete.
claims.quote: In scenarios where Purview inspection is unable to complete, such as a payload that is too large to inspect, or an internal error, the traffic is allowed (fail-open).

claims.claim: Microsoft says to allow up to 24 hours after integration configuration for distribution and initial data.
claims.quote: After you configure the integration between Microsoft Purview and your network security solution, allow up to 24 hours for your policies to be distributed to the network security solution and for the first data to show up.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Activity explorer can filter network data security events by enforcement plane set to network.
claims.quote: In activity explorer, you can filter events with enforcement plane set to network. This filter shows you activities that network data security policies generate.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The GSA Traffic logs PurviewStatus field identifies transactions that skipped inspection.
claims.quote: Transactions that have skipped inspection can be identified in Traffic logs using PurviewStatus field.

claims.claim: The DLP walkthrough notes that some scenario features are in preview.
claims.quote: Some features used in this scenario are in preview.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model, licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Network data security through GSA has per-seat entitlement, with Microsoft 365 E7 as one licence route.
claims.quote: Network data security with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access requires one of the following license combinations: Microsoft 365 E7 per-seat licenses

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The alternative GSA licence route is Purview E5 or equivalent per-seat licences and Entra Internet Access or equivalent licences.
claims.quote: Purview E5 (or equivalent) per-seat licenses and Entra Internet Access (or equivalent) licenses

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Users also require Entra ID P1 or P2 to use Entra Internet Access.
claims.quote: To use Microsoft Entra Private Access and Microsoft Entra Internet Access, users need a Microsoft Entra ID P1 or Microsoft Entra ID P2 license.

claims.claim: The network data security overview says pay-as-you-go setup is not required for GSA integration.
claims.quote: Pay-as-you-go is not required to be set up for integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access.
claims.fix: Keep the GSA-specific statement, but add: 'The general Purview billing-models table also lists Network Data Security under pay-as-you-go without distinguishing integrations; the network data security overview explicitly exempts GSA from pay-as-you-go setup.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/purview-billing-models.

claims.claim: Non-Microsoft SASE and secure browser integrations require pay-as-you-go setup.
claims.quote: You must configure pay-as-you-go for your Microsoft 365 tenant to use Purview network data security with non-Microsoft SASE and secure browser solutions.

claims.claim: The Entra content-policy prerequisites list a valid Internet Access licence and a valid Purview licence for Scan with Purview.
claims.quote: A valid Microsoft Entra Internet Access license. A valid Microsoft Purview license, required for Scan with Purview inspection.

claims.claim: The Entra page's missing-DLP note names Microsoft 365 E5/A5 or a Purview DLP add-on.
claims.quote: If you don't see Data loss prevention in Microsoft Purview ... You need a role such as DLP Compliance Management or Information Protection Admin, and a Microsoft 365 E5/A5 subscription or a Microsoft Purview DLP add-on.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No price specific to the all-websites scope is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview network data security all websites 575285 default existing policies licensing price scope; "Purview" "all websites" "default" "price". Read network data security licensing and billing, Purview billing models and Entra licensing overview; none publishes a scope-specific price.

claims.claim: No meter or rate specific to the all-websites scope is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview network data security all websites 575285 default existing policies licensing price scope. Read network data security overview and Purview billing models; the generic request meter is documented, but no all-websites-specific meter or rate is.

claims.claim: No licence rule specific to the all-websites scope is published, beyond documented GSA network data security requirements.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview network data security all websites 575285 default existing policies licensing price scope. Read network data security licensing, Entra content-policy prerequisites and GSA licensing overview; no separate entitlement for the new scope is stated.

claims.claim: Initial GSA content-policy setup requires enabling the Internet Access traffic forwarding profile.
claims.quote: Enable the Internet Access traffic forwarding profile and ensure correct user assignments.

claims.claim: The Purview path shown reaches the adaptive app scope selection for a network DLP policy.
claims.quote: Select Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy. ... Select Custom from the Categories list and then select Custom policy from the Regulations list. ... Select + Add cloud apps. Select the Adaptive app scopes tab, then choose All unmanaged AI apps
claims.fix: Expand controls[0].ui.path and its rendered row to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Inline web traffic > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom policy > + Add cloud apps > Adaptive app scopes > app scope'. Categories and Regulations are omitted headings, not wrong choices.

claims.claim: No documented automation selects the cloud app scope of a network DLP policy.
claims.quote: Searched: New-DlpCompliancePolicy network cloud apps scope parameters PowerShell. Read New/Set-DlpCompliancePolicy parameter lists and linked non-Microsoft cloud-app guide; ThirdPartyAppDlpLocation addresses connected Instances, not network app scopes.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Purview path shown reaches Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers enforcement.
claims.quote: Select Custom from the Categories list and then select Custom policy from the Regulations list. ... On the Choose where to enforce the policy page, ensure Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers is On
claims.fix: Expand controls[1].ui.path and its rendered row to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Inline web traffic > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom policy > + Add cloud apps > Adaptive app scopes > app scope > Choose where to enforce the policy > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers'.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -EnforcementPlanes @("Network") creates a policy with the Network enforcement plane.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell. ... The EnforcementPlanes parameter defines the layer where policy actions are run. ... -EnforcementPlanes @("<Value>"). Valid values are: ... Network

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].note; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Entra path reaches the Rules page, where a new rule's Action can be set to Scan with Purview.
claims.quote: Browse to Global Secure Access > Secure > Content policies. ... Select + Create Policy. ... On the Rules tab: Add a new rule. ... To use data policies configured in Microsoft Purview, select Scan with Purview.
claims.fix: Expand controls[2].ui.path and its rendered row to 'Global Secure Access > Secure > Content policies > + Create Policy > Basics > Rules > rule > Action > Scan with Purview'. Retain the note explaining that the rule is added on Rules. The current path stops on the correct page but not at the action.

claims.claim: No documented API configures the content-rule Scan with Purview action; the cited content-policy page gives portal instructions.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Global Secure Access content filtering policy rules Scan with Purview action API; contentFilteringRule scanWithPurview networkaccess. Read Entra content-policy page and Graph filteringPolicy/filteringRule references; no scan action is documented.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to investigate with Purview and GSA monitoring tools, but neither monitoring control appears in the controls table.
claims.quote: After rollout: 'Investigate user reports with the documented Purview and GSA monitoring tools.' Controls table: app scope, network enforcement, and sending content for inspection only.
claims.fix: Remove the After rollout checklist bullet 'Investigate user reports with the documented Purview and GSA monitoring tools.' The verified monitoring advice can remain in Risk assessment; do not add control rows during this correction.

claims.claim: Conditional Access Administrator is required to configure Conditional Access policies.
claims.quote: A Conditional Access Administrator role to configure Conditional Access policies.

claims.claim: The activities and actions selected in the GSA content policy and Purview DLP rule should match.
claims.quote: The actions you select in the Purview DLP rule should match the content types and activities you selected in the Global Secure Access content policy.

claims.claim: Network DLP can generate alerts for matching traffic in its scope when alerts are configured.
claims.quote: If a data loss prevention policy is matched, and you have configured alerts, they will be available in DLP alerts.

claims.claim: The Purview DLP walkthrough specifies an Entra ID joined device for GSA integration.
claims.quote: If you're using Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access ... The device must be Entra ID joined.

claims.claim: Initial content-policy setup requires installing and configuring the GSA client on Windows or macOS and routing internet traffic through GSA.
claims.quote: Install and configure the Global Secure Access client: Install the Global Secure Access client on Windows or macOS. ... Before you continue, test and ensure your client's internet traffic is routed through Global Secure Access.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference lists Network as an EnforcementPlanes value without explaining that particular value.
claims.quote: Valid values are: ... Browser: For use with policies applied to unmanaged cloud apps in Edge for Business. ... Network

claims.claim: Broadening app scope does not by itself exempt Scan with Purview traffic from the documented inspection limits.
claims.quote: The maximum supported content size for Scan with Purview is 3 MB for both file and text content types. OCR is not yet supported for traffic sent to Purview.
